name: Ranger Brutal Shot: a 40 yd line that pierces armor and always crits during Skirmish (#1284)
contract: Brutal Shot 570014 reads 'Fire a volley of powerful shots that pierce through Armor, dealing $s2% Ranged Weapon Damage plus ${$m1+0} to all targets in a $a1 yd line. While Skirmish is active this ability is guaranteed to critically strike.' Spell.dbc targets every effect at TARGET_UNIT_CONE_ENEMY_24 (radius index 23 = 40 yd) plus the explicit enemy; the client's SpellCustomAttr row 21100 for 570014 carries 0x8004 = SPELL_ATTR0_CU_CONE_LINE | SPELL_ATTR0_CU_IGNORE_ARMOR in AzerothCore's layout, which the server never applied, so the volley hit a 24 degree cone and was reduced by armor. 'Guaranteed to crit while Skirmish' is the hidden record 803335 'Skirmish' rank 'SLS' (a Skirmish-linked spell, like the Elude SLS records the server already applies with Elude): SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE +100 on Brutal Shot's SpellFamilyFlags (128,0,0); nothing applied it. Its mask also names word-2 bit 2, which in family 27 is only Waterskin and Bone Reliquary Heal, so the load contract narrows it to Brutal Shot, the one ability the tooltip names. Expected: neither damage effect is armor-reduced; with Skirmish (802039) active the Ranger carries 803335 and Brutal Shot's crit chance is at least 100, and it crits; after Skirmish ends 803335 is gone; an enemy 35 yd away but 5.9 yd off the Ranger's facing (o = 0.17 rad, inside the 24 degree cone, outside a line two object sizes wide) is not hit, while the explicit target is. Both golems are stunned so they keep their positions.
